cohort: Women who underwent postpartum hysterectomy due to postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) at gestational week 23+0 or later
finding: Adenomyosis was found in 39.4% of women who underwent postpartum hysterectomy due to PPH and was significantly associated with longer hospitalization, increased risk of hypertensive disorders, threatened preterm labor, urgent/emergency C-section, postpartum maternal complications, maternal intensive care unit admission, and low birth weight neonates.
